fields.description:
## Discovered from

CI run 32553346737 on Gerrit change 2065 (ticket d893-e003-0539-47fc): pytest (ubuntu-latest,
py3.12) failed tests/unit/test_plan_review.py::test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes
with 'rebar-version: 0.12.0 (f5fb6e45-dirty)' != 'rebar-version: 0.12.0 (f5fb6e45)' — the -dirty
suffix flipped BETWEEN two build_manifest calls inside one test. The same test passes locally.

## Root cause (confirmed by deterministic reproduction)

src/rebar/llm/plan_review/manifest.py:497 stamps every manifest with
`_signing.gate_code_version()`, which shells `git status --porcelain` on the rebar source
checkout PER CALL (src/rebar/_signing_manifest.py:_gate_commit_sha). Two byte-equality tests
compare manifests built by SEPARATE calls:

- tests/unit/test_plan_review.py:965-966 (test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes)
- tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py:79 (equality of two build_manifest outputs)

Under pytest-xdist another worker that transiently creates/removes a file in the checkout
(or any concurrent writer) flips the dirty-state between the calls, so the assertion compares
racy live-git provenance rather than the file-scope/pins contract under test. Reproduced
deterministically: creating a scratch file in the checkout between the two calls makes the
equality fail with exactly the CI diff.

## Approach

Pin the provenance in the affected test: monkeypatch `rebar.signing.gate_code_version` to a
constant in test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes — manifest.py binds
`from rebar import signing as _signing` (manifest.py:475) and calls
`_signing.gate_code_version()` at call time (manifest.py:497), so pinning the attribute on the
`rebar.signing` facade module is what the call site actually resolves through; no production
code changes. This is the exact pattern the OTHER byte-equality test already uses:
tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py::test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes already
monkeypatches `rebar.signing.gate_code_version` to a constant around its line-79 equality, so
after this fix every manifest byte-equality test in the repo is pinned and the flake class is
closed.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] test_manifest_file_scope_contract_preserves_legacy_bytes pins
      `rebar.signing.gate_code_version` (monkeypatch, like
      test_no_pins_preserves_legacy_manifest_bytes) and passes even when a file is created in
      the checkout between its build_manifest calls — verified by running the test with the
      reproduction interleaving.
- [ ] A repo grep shows no remaining test byte-compares two separately-built manifests without
      pinning gate_code_version (the only other site, tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py:79,
      is already pinned by its enclosing test).
